display.title: Episode 211: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 2 (Shabbos Mevarchim Adar)
display.summary_short: Adding joy as Adar approaches, Shema with a young guest, and the wedding of the orphans, where a mysterious rabbi and his ten students arrive with astonishing gifts.
display.summary_long: Broadcast a few days before Shabbos Mevarchim Adar 5746. Uncle Yossi explains 'mishenichnas Adar marbin b'simcha': we always serve Hashem with joy, but when Adar comes we add even more, until the greatest joy of all, leaving golus with Moshiach. After the Hakochainik march and a recap, a nine-year-old guest leads the Shema. 'The Ten Wedding Gifts' continues: Reuven praises Avraham and Sarah for the mitzvah of freeing a captive, sends them back to the fair at his own expense, and invites the whole town to their wedding. As the chuppah is about to begin, a holy-looking rabbi with ten students walks in, and Reuven asks him to say the brachos. Uncle Yossi explains why the chuppah stands under the open sky. At the meal the guest reveals that he is the Baal Shem Tov, sent by the Heavenly court to bless them. Each of his ten students announces a gift, a park, a lumberyard and more, all belonging to local poritzim. Then the Baal Shem Tov's wagon speeds off with no driver, to be continued. In Mitzvah Time, Uncle Yossi teaches never to leave a Chumash on the floor or upside down.
display.lesson: Hashem's watchful eye sees every act of kindness and rewards it in full; and in Adar we add to our joy.
